collectionScope: The Librarians: The Next Chapter Season 1, mapped into the continuing SceneSense Librarians chronology as Season 5.
description: A nineteenth-century Librarian, Vikram Chamberlain, reappears in present-day Belgrade and accidentally reactivates a Library along with dangerous magic. He assembles Charlie, Lysa and Connor into a new team while racing to contain the consequences and the return of General Gregor.

s05e01.description: Vikram Chamberlain, a Librarian displaced from the nineteenth century, reopens a dormant Library in modern Belgrade and accidentally releases a murderous Drekavac, forcing him to assemble a new team quickly.

s05e02.description: A supernatural dancing sickness spreads through a ballet company, and the newly formed Librarians must identify the magical force compelling performers before the deadly rhythm spreads further.

s05e03.description: Part of the team becomes trapped aboard a runaway ghost train, leaving the others to uncover the passengers' unresolved past before the spectral journey ends in destruction.

s05e04.description: A trail of robberies in Paris leaves victims hopelessly infatuated, leading the Librarians to a stolen love artifact and an uneasy consultation with Cupid.

s05e05.description: At a university observatory, someone uses John Dee's memory crystal to steal knowledge from victims, forcing the team to stop an attempt to control the future by erasing the past.

s05e06.description: The magic door strands Charlie, Lysa and Connor inside an isolated manor where guests are being murdered in classic mystery fashion, while Vikram searches for a way to reach them.

s05e07.description: Connor's former life catches up with him when the team enters a convention full of con artists and rivals, forcing him to defeat an adversary who has prospered in his absence.

s05e08.description: After a chaotic bachelorette party, the team wakes with missing memories and a serious problem, reconstructing the previous night to discover what really happened and who cannot be trusted.

s05e09.description: At a small-town festival, Connor encounters the original vampire and races to prevent his own transformation before the infection becomes permanent.

s05e10.description: Vikram's improvised time machine sends the whole team back to Arthurian Britain, where they become entangled with Camelot, the Round Table and a legend that differs sharply from history.

s05e11.description: Living graffiti begins attacking a teenage girl, and the team traces the manifestations to Gregor's Hammer and signs that a dangerous old enemy is about to return.

s05e12.description: General Gregor seizes the Sword of Mars and uses its power to take control of Caucasylvia and its nuclear arsenal, forcing the Librarians into a theft that may prevent a global catastrophe.
